acceptanceCriteria: Harvest honours the configured or discovered app map path.
A focused test covers a non-default map path.
body: Residual from lane cce2-1022u (PR beamfall/corvint#1553, seal 751a2a15d). The deterministic harvester ignores app maps at non-default paths or names, so adopters with a configured map path get no harvested blocks.
title: CCE harvest reads only the default appmap.json
